subsystems.name: Source Registry
subsystems.justification: Gold-standard events prove multi-source origins work; registry needs explicit evidence-tier and bot-block metadata per source.

subsystems.name: Connector Layer
subsystems.justification: ticket-io and ticket-kings connectors produce evidence but ALTCHA/list/checkout hops are inconsistent (LEVI vs Ship).

subsystems.name: Import Layer
subsystems.justification: import_records + normalized candidates are stable; evolve job orchestration without replacing candidate model.

subsystems.name: Evidence Model
subsystems.justification: Metadata on import_records exists but lacks uniform tiering (list/detail/checkout) and blocked-state typing.

subsystems.name: Merge Engine
subsystems.justification: Underland ticket.io URL vs affenkaefig TK offer shows merge correctly prefers ticketing source; Ship sold-out merge works.

subsystems.name: Canonical Event
subsystems.justification: events table + admin record mapping is the stable persistence anchor across all 8 reference events.

subsystems.name: Ticket Domain
subsystems.justification: readCanonicalTicket/writeCanonicalTicket separation is correct; extend for third-hop checkout and blocked evidence states.

subsystems.name: Lineup Domain
subsystems.justification: MDMA garbage filtering works post-Gate C but public "Folgt noch" vs structured lineup contract is immature.

subsystems.name: Venue Domain
subsystems.justification: Venue labels differ in quality between Bootshaus-linked vs external venues; denormalized fields need trust rules.

subsystems.name: Media Domain
subsystems.justification: Flyer/gallery from bootshaus.tv og:image and affenkaefig JSON-LD image propagate to consumer gallery projection.

subsystems.name: Projection Layer
subsystems.justification: projectCanonicalEventFields is the single consumer truth path; some fields (date on bootshaus.tv) need richer public parsers.

subsystems.name: Consumer Layer
subsystems.justification: Ticket badge + display price bridge correctly reflects canonical ticket domain for TK and Ticket.io events.

subsystems.name: Review System
subsystems.justification: Review queue still needed for lineup_partial and slug-drift cases (Sommerfest); integrate with evidence gaps not audit scores.

subsystems.name: Audit System
subsystems.justification: Phase 4.7 audits missed public-truth gaps (73 field divergences vs public). Audits must consume ground-truth harness.

isEventEngineFundamentallyReusable.justification: Canonical event persistence, merge engine, ticket read/write, and projection layer produce correct consumer output when public evidence is extractable (Ship, Underland, MDMA checkout path).

partsAlreadyCorrect.justification: Validated on Ship sold-out, Underland Ticket.io CTA, TK Nacht-Manager checkout enrichment.

answer: Lineup Domain (public partial vs structured contract)
partsToModernize.justification: Root causes: Third-party platform (13), Evidence Extraction gaps, Connector gaps.

partsToRebuild.justification: No full subsystem rebuild required — gaps are incremental modernization targets.

partsNeverTouch.justification: These components are proven on gold-standard reference events and should anchor Import Platform v2.

reusedUnchangedIfRebuiltToday.justification: Minimize rewrite: reuse proven persistence and projection; modernize connector evidence extraction only.
